physics-killer-06.title: Pamusoro peplane yakachinjika isina
physics-killer-06.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
physics-killer-06.material: Pamusoro peplane yakachinjika isina friction, chinhu A chine huremu $2\,\mathrm{kg}$ chinofamba nokumhanya $6\,\mathrm{m/s}$ uye chinorovera chinhu B chine huremu $4\,\mathrm{kg}$ chakamira, mushure mazvo zvinhu zviviri zvinonamira ndokufamba pamwe chete. Kana nguva yokurovera iri $0.05\,\mathrm{s}$, kumhanya kwezvinhu zviviri pakarepo mushure mokurovera nehuwandu hwesimba pakati rinogamuchirwa naB panguva yokurovera ndeapi zvichitevedzana?
physics-killer-06.s.s1.prompt: Pamusoro peplane yakachinjika isina friction, chinhu A chine huremu $2\,\mathrm{kg}$ chinofamba nokumhanya $6\,\mathrm{m/s}$ uye chinorovera chinhu B chine huremu $4\,\mathrm{kg}$ chakamira, mushure mazvo zvinhu zviviri zvinonamira ndokufamba pamwe chete. Kana nguva yokurovera iri $0.05\,\mathrm{s}$, kumhanya kwezvinhu zviviri pakarepo mushure mokurovera nehuwandu hwesimba pakati rinogamuchirwa naB panguva yokurovera ndeapi zvichitevedzana?
physics-killer-06.s.s1.explain: Kuchengetedzwa kwemomentum: $2\cdot6=(2+4)v\Rightarrow v=2\,\mathrm{m/s}$. Shanduko yemomentum yaB $\Delta p_B=4\cdot2-0=8\,\mathrm{kg\cdot m/s}$ saka $F_{avg}=\dfrac{8}{0.05}=160\,\mathrm{N}$. (Shanduko yemomentum yaA $2(2-6)=-8$ yakaenzana nehukuru, saka zvinoenderana.) Kushandisa $m_A$ chete pachinzvimbo cheiyo huremu hwakabatana kunopa $v=3\,\mathrm{m/s}$ nhema ①, kushandisa momentum yepakutanga yaA $12$ pakuverenga simba kunopa $240\,\mathrm{N}$ (nhema ②), kushandisa $v_B=4\,\mathrm{m/s}$ yeelastic collision ndiyo nhema ③.
